name: Copilot Home
desc: The starting screen in Copilot, where Chat and Cowork meet.
desc_zh: Copilot 的起始界面，Chat 和 Cowork 在这里汇合。
solves: You never know which mode to open, so you start in the wrong one. Home has one composer that routes the request to Chat, Cowork or Code.
solves_zh: 不知道该开哪个模式，于是每次都从错的开始。Home 只有一个输入框，会把请求分派给 Chat、Cowork 或 Code。
best_for: You open Copilot and are not sure whether this is a question or a task.
best_for_zh: 你打开 Copilot，说不清这到底是提问还是派活。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft Copilot Blog (Ignite 2026), https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilo）。 Announced 2026-09-25 with a Frontier rollout over the following weeks; general availability 2026-11-17. Today, the proactive command centre inside Home, is in private preview. Home is the new entry point of the Copilot app rather than a separate product. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/11/17/copilot-at-microsoft-ignite-expanding-whats-possible-with-intelligence-built-for-work/
